title: Dexcom Sensor Error
shortDescription: App reports the sensor cannot provide a reading temporarily.
fullDescription:
A Sensor Error on Dexcom G6 or G7 means the system has paused readings due to unreliable data. This is often temporary and resolves within 3 hours without action. Common causes include compression while sleeping on the sensor, sudden hydration changes, or a warmup delay.

If Sensor Error persists longer than 3 hours, replace the sensor. Do not finger-stick calibrate unless your system prompts you and you have confirmed a discrepancy with a blood glucose meter.

fixSteps.title: Wait up to 3 hours
fixSteps.instruction: Most sensor errors self-resolve. Do not remove the sensor prematurely.

fixSteps.title: Check placement
fixSteps.instruction: Avoid sleeping or pressing on the sensor site.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If error exceeds 3 hours or returns, start a new sensor session and contact Dexcom for replacement.

whenToCallPro: Contact Dexcom Technical Support for a replacement sensor if the error persists. Use a finger-stick meter to monitor glucose and contact your healthcare provider with any acute concerns.

faq.a: No, once the sensor resumes readings, gaps fill with estimated values when possible.
G6 allows manual calibration; G7 does not. Follow app prompts only.

title: Dexcom Signal Loss
shortDescription: App lost Bluetooth connection to the sensor/transmitter.
fullDescription:
Signal Loss means the Dexcom app cannot reach the sensor over Bluetooth. The transmitter has a range of about 20 feet. Phones in another room, Bluetooth toggled off, or battery-saver modes are common causes.

When reconnected, the app back-fills missed readings up to 3 hours.

fixSteps.title: Get closer
fixSteps.instruction: Keep phone within 20 feet (6 m) of sensor with line of sight.

fixSteps.title: Check Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Verify Bluetooth is on and app has permission.

fixSteps.title: Disable battery saver
fixSteps.instruction: Disable battery optimization for Dexcom G6/G7 app.

whenToCallPro: Contact Dexcom support if signal loss persists with phone next to sensor.

faq.a: Yes, up to 3 hours of missed readings back-fill when reconnected.

title: Dexcom G6 Transmitter Pairing Failed
shortDescription: App cannot pair with new transmitter or sensor.
fullDescription:
On Dexcom G6, a removable transmitter has a unique serial number that must be entered in the app when starting a new sensor. Pairing fails if the serial is mistyped or the transmitter is too far from the phone.

On G7, the transmitter is integrated into the sensor and pairing uses a sensor code printed on the applicator.

fixSteps.title: Verify code
fixSteps.instruction: Re-enter the transmitter SN or G7 4-digit code exactly as printed.

fixSteps.title: Stay close
fixSteps.instruction: Keep phone within 6 inches of sensor during pairing.

fixSteps.title: Restart app
fixSteps.instruction: Force close and reopen Dexcom app, retry pairing.

whenToCallPro: Call Dexcom support if a correct code still fails to pair.

faq.a: G6 on back of transmitter, G7 on the applicator label.

title: Dexcom Receiver Out of Range
fullDescription: The optional Dexcom dedicated receiver has the same ~20 ft Bluetooth range as a phone. Out of Range displays when contact is lost. Bring the receiver closer and it will reconnect automatically.

fixSteps.title: Move receiver
fixSteps.instruction: Bring receiver within 20 feet of sensor.

faq.a: Yes, walls and bodies reduce effective range below 20 ft.

title: Dexcom G6 Calibration Error
shortDescription: Entered calibration value differs significantly from sensor reading.
fullDescription:
On Dexcom G6, if a manually entered finger-stick value differs too much from the sensor's estimate, the app requests a retest. Only calibrate with a washed, dry finger using a reliable BG meter.

G7 users cannot calibrate - the sensor is factory-calibrated.

fixSteps.title: Wash hands
fixSteps.instruction: Wash with soap and water, dry thoroughly.

fixSteps.title: Wait 15 min
fixSteps.instruction: Allow glucose to stabilize, then retest with BG meter and re-enter.

whenToCallPro: Consult your healthcare provider if sensor remains inaccurate after proper calibration.

faq.a: Only when prompted. G7 does not require or allow calibration.

title: Dexcom No Readings Available
shortDescription: Sensor is active but not producing glucose numbers.
fullDescription: The No Readings icon appears during warm-up or when the sensor is temporarily unable to report. G6 has a 2-hour warm-up, G7 has 30 minutes. Do not finger-stick or remove the sensor during this period.

fixSteps.title: Check timer
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm sensor is still warming up - G6 takes 2 hrs, G7 takes 30 min.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Allow full warm-up or up to 3 hours for temporary errors.

whenToCallPro: Contact Dexcom if no readings appear after warm-up plus 3 hours.

faq.a: Yes - use a BG meter for therapy decisions until CGM reports.

title: Dexcom Sensor Session Ended
fullDescription: Dexcom sensors are approved for 10 days of wear (G6) or 10 days plus 12-hour grace period (G7). When the session ends, remove the sensor and apply a new one.

fixSteps.title: Remove old sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Peel off adhesive slowly using oil to loosen if needed.

fixSteps.title: Apply new sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate sites - abdomen, arm, or upper buttocks depending on model.

fixSteps.title: Start new session
fixSteps.instruction: Enter sensor code in app to begin.

faq.a: Yes, G7 offers an optional 12-hour grace period to insert the new sensor before the old ends.

title: Dexcom Sensor Failed
shortDescription: Sensor ended prematurely and cannot be restarted.
fullDescription: A Sensor Failed message indicates the sensor ended before its 10-day session. This can happen due to dislodgement, severe compression, or internal sensor failure. Dexcom will typically replace failed sensors at no charge.

fixSteps.title: Remove sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the failed sensor from your body.

fixSteps.title: Contact Dexcom
fixSteps.instruction: Call Dexcom Technical Support to request a replacement under warranty.

fixSteps.title: Apply new sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Once replacement arrives, apply and start a new session.

whenToCallPro: Always call Dexcom for a replacement - keep failed sensor for RMA if requested. Use a finger-stick BG meter until replacement arrives.

faq.a: Yes, Dexcom typically replaces failed sensors at no charge within warranty.

title: Dexcom False Low from Compression
shortDescription: Sensor reports falsely low reading when compressed.
fullDescription: Compression lows happen when you sleep on the sensor, reducing blood flow and causing a falsely low reading. If you wake feeling fine but the CGM alarms at night, check position. Confirm with a finger-stick before treating any low.

fixSteps.title: Verify with BG meter
fixSteps.instruction: Always confirm low readings with a finger-stick before treating.

fixSteps.title: Change position
fixSteps.instruction: Shift off the sensor to restore blood flow.

fixSteps.title: Relocate sensor
fixSteps.instruction: For next sensor, choose a site not under your sleeping position.

whenToCallPro: If you experience frequent compression lows, discuss sensor placement strategies with your diabetes educator.

faq.a: Only after confirming with a finger-stick. Treating a false low can cause rebound highs.

title: Dexcom App Bluetooth Connectivity Issues
shortDescription: Persistent Bluetooth drops on iOS or Android.
fullDescription: Phone OS updates often disrupt Dexcom Bluetooth. Symptoms include frequent signal loss or app not waking up. Updating the Dexcom app to the current version and disabling battery optimization resolves most issues.

fixSteps.title: Update app
fixSteps.instruction: Install the latest Dexcom G6 or G7 app from App Store or Play Store.

fixSteps.title: Disable battery optimization
fixSteps.instruction: Android: Settings > Apps > Dexcom > Battery > Unrestricted. iOS: no action needed.

fixSteps.title: Check permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure Bluetooth, notifications, and background refresh are enabled.

whenToCallPro: Dexcom support if issues continue on a compatible phone with the latest app.

faq.a: Check the Dexcom compatibility page before OS updates - not all phones are supported.
